title: Historical Prototype Commit Leaked Secret in Git History
verifiedBy: git log regex audit & external SECURITY_PRIVATE.md
description: Historical prototype commit 0ed56f4 contained an API key in public git history. Working tree and build output are clean. Status is OPEN pending owner revocation in Google AI Studio and git history scrubbing.

title: Missing Clickjacking (X-Frame-Options) and HSTS HTTP Headers
description: Added X-Frame-Options: DENY and Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload to vercel.json headers.

title: Prototype Pollution and Unbounded File Size Vulnerability in Preset Import
description: Added 2MB file size guard, JSON reviver stripping __proto__/constructor/prototype, 100-preset max limit, and single batch localStorage write.

title: Caption List Textarea StopPropagation Prevents Caption Card Selection
description: Textarea in caption card stopped propagation without selecting segment, stranding editor in 'all' scope. Added onSelectSegment(seg.id) and onSeek(seg.start) to onClick and onFocus.

title: Library Panel Tabs Missing WAI-ARIA Tablist and Tab Semantics
description: Library panel tabs lacked role='tablist', role='tab', and aria-selected. Added WAI-ARIA attributes across all navigation tabs.

title: Missing override Modifiers in TypeScript ErrorBoundary
description: Enabled noImplicitOverride in tsconfig.app.json and added override keyword to componentDidCatch and render methods in RootErrorBoundary.

title: GitHub Actions Not Pinned to Full Commit SHA and Missing Permissions
verifiedBy: ci.yml inspection & local E2E test run
description: Pinned actions to 40-character immutable commit SHAs, added permissions: contents: read, and wired Playwright Chromium E2E verification step.

title: Vitest Runner Globbing Playwright E2E Specs Causing Execution Collision
description: Vitest test runner defaulted to running e2e/*.spec.ts files. Added exclude: ['**/node_modules/**', '**/dist/**', '**/e2e/**'] to vite.config.ts.

title: Over-sized Bundle Chunk from Mediabunny Exceeding 500kB
description: MediaBunny WebCodecs engine weighs 765kB minified (195kB gzip). Already split into independent manualChunk loaded on demand.

title: Applying Template in Playback Gap Overrides All Captions
description: Decoupled user selection (selectedId) from playhead position (activeId). Applying template in caption scope targets selectedId only.

title: Silent and Sticky Editor Scope Switching
description: Exposed explicit scope switcher button group (All / Caption / Words) with persistent badges and prevented Escape key inside inputs from wiping scope.

title: Dead Buttons and Sliders in Per-Caption Mode
description: Added per-caption override branches for bold, italic, underline, font size, and text case in SegmentStyleOverride.

title: Controls Ignoring Scope and Mutating Global Styles
description: Routed effects and style modifications through applyStyleChange with scope validation.

title: Global Styles Blocked by Existing Overrides Without Reset Path
description: Added 'Reset all overrides' action in options menu and visible override badges on customized segments.

title: Splitting a Caption Loses StyleOverride and Speaker on Second Half
description: Ensured handleSplit preserves styleOverride and speaker across both split segments.

title: 60Hz Re-renders During Playback Slowing Sliders
description: Wrapped LibraryPanel and InspectorPanel in React.memo and decoupled time ticks from top-level state tree.

title: Fragile and Incomplete Undo/Redo State
description: Made history updates pure and preserved segment style overrides across undo and redo operations.

title: 10 Dev-Only npm audit Vulnerabilities in Tooling (minimatch ReDoS)
description: All 10 moderate vulnerabilities reside in devDependencies (eslint, @typescript-eslint, minimatch). Production runtime bundles are 100% clean (0 prod vulns). Fix path: ESLint 9 / typescript-eslint 8.36+ upgrade.

title: Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only Without Unsafe Inline
description: Configured strict Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only header in vercel.json. Disallowed 'unsafe-inline' for scripts, externalized chunk reload script, and pruned connect-src to only 'self' and Gemini API.

title: Mobile Viewport (393px) Inspector & Timeline Unreachable in Small Screen
description: Fixed 4 Mobile Chrome failures: added inspector mobile tab, corrected caption stopPropagation click event, and synchronized tab switcher.

title: WebKit / Safari Lacks canvas.captureStream & WebAudio Device Crash
verifiedBy: Prebuilt static demo video & WebKit test suite (25/25 pass)
description: Replaced dynamic canvas.captureStream synthetic video generation with prebuilt static MP4 reel (assets/demo-reel.mp4). Added Web Audio API fallback in extractAudio.ts for environments lacking AudioContext. Real Safari physical hardware verification remains owner responsibility.

title: Multi-Browser Test Matrix & Automated Security Scanners Missing in CI
description: Configured Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, and Mobile Chrome in CI with artifact upload on failure. Added GitHub Actions workflow for Gitleaks, OSV-Scanner, and Semgrep.
